coordinated_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face and brushing teeth, getting dressed for the day
Preparing and eating breakfast, boiling water with the kettle and making toast
Packing work bag, checking phone for shift notes and reviewing the day's patient schedule on the computer
Commuting to the health care facility
Working as a health care professional: patient assessments, clinical documentation, medication rounds and coordinating with the care team
Commuting home from the health care facility
Cooking dinner using the induction cooker and oven, then eating dinner
Cleaning up after dinner, loading the dishwasher and wiping down the counters
Relaxing on the sofa watching TV
Doing a load of laundry in the washing machine and running the clothes dryer
Taking a shower with the water heater and getting ready for bed
Quiet wind-down time: reading and checking personal phone, dimming the bedroom light
